events.content: Now I understand the structure. Prompt templates are `.md` files stored in `~/.pi/agent/prompts/` (global, available in all sessions). Let me create the template:

arguments.content: Tell me the current time and timezone.

events.content:
Done! I've created the global prompt template at:

**`~/.pi/agent/prompts/current-time.md`**

This makes `/current-time` available as a slash command in all your Pi sessions. When you type `/current-time`, it will expand to:

```
Tell me the current time and timezone.
```

Since it's in the global `~/.pi/agent/prompts/` directory (not a project-specific `.pi/prompts/` directory), it will be available across all sessions regardless of the working directory.
Tell me the current time and timezone.

I don't have access to a tool that can retrieve the current system time (no bash/shell execution tool is available in this session). My available tools are limited to file operations: `read`, `write`, `edit`, `grep`, `find`, and `ls`.

To get the current time and timezone, you could run:

```bash
date
```

or for more detail:

```bash
date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z (UTC%:z)'
```

If you'd like me to have this capability in future sessions, you could add a custom tool or ensure the bash tool is enabled.
